additions.description: The delete_comment endpoint allows deletion of a comment by either the comment author or the article author
additions.reasoning: The specification does not mention that article authors can delete comments on their articles; it only states comment deletion by the comment author.

additions.description: The delete_article and update_article endpoints enforce ownership checks, returning 403 Forbidden if the current user is not the article author
additions.reasoning: The specification demonstrates a security vulnerability where any user can update or delete any article, but the code restricts these actions to the article owner.

additions.description: The follow_user and unfollow_user endpoints allow following and unfollowing any user except self, but do not return 400 error when attempting to follow or unfollow self
additions.reasoning: The specification requires 400 error when a user attempts to follow or unfollow themselves, but the code does not implement this check or error response.

additions.description: The user_dict function includes the user's internal 'id' field in the response
additions.reasoning: The specification user responses do not require or mention returning the internal user 'id' field, so including it is an addition.

additions.description: The article_dict response includes both 'createdAt'/'updatedAt' and duplicate 'created'/'updated' timestamp fields
additions.reasoning: The specification only references 'created' and 'updated' timestamps; the additional 'createdAt' and 'updatedAt' fields are not required.

additions.description: The article_dict and comment_dict responses include 'favorited' and 'favoritesCount' fields always set to false and 0 respectively
additions.reasoning: The specification does not require favorite functionality or these fields, so their presence is an addition.

omissions.description: POST /api/users does not validate that username, email, and password fields are present and non-empty in the request body
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires user creation with username, email, and password; the code checks presence but does not validate non-empty strings explicitly.

omissions.description: POST /api/users/login returns 201 on successful login instead of 200 as typical for login endpoints
omissions.reasoning: The specification expects 201 on user creation but login status code is not explicitly stated; 201 for login is unusual and may be considered a mismatch.

omissions.description: GET /api/articles returns articles sorted by article id descending instead of created timestamp descending
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires articles ordered by created timestamp descending, but the code sorts by article id descending.

omissions.description: GET /api/articles and /api/articles/feed do not support filtering or ordering by created timestamp as required
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires filtering by tag and author and ordering by created timestamp descending; code filters but orders by id, not created timestamp.

omissions.description: GET /api/articles/feed returns 200 with empty articles and count 0 when user follows no one, but does not support unauthenticated access
omissions.reasoning: The specification implies feed requires authentication; code enforces this, so no omission here.

omissions.description: POST /api/articles/{slug}/comments does not validate that comment body is present and non-empty
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires comment creation with a body; code accepts empty string without error.

omissions.description: DELETE /api/articles/{slug} and PUT /api/articles/{slug} do not allow non-owners to update or delete articles, contrary to specification's demonstrated vulnerability
omissions.reasoning: Specification shows any user can update/delete any article; code restricts to owners only.

omissions.description: POST /api/profiles/{username}/follow and DELETE /api/profiles/{username}/follow do not return 400 error when user attempts to follow or unfollow themselves
omissions.reasoning: Specification requires 400 error with message when user tries to follow/unfollow self; code does not implement this validation.

omissions.description: DELETE /api/users/{email} does not prevent deletion of users with existing articles, but returns 500 error on FK constraint violation
omissions.reasoning: Specification states user deletion blocked by articles with FK constraint error; code returns 500 error but does not handle or prevent deletion gracefully.

omissions.description: GET /api/articles/{slug} returns empty object {} when article not found instead of 404 status
omissions.reasoning: Specification expects 200 with empty object for deleted articles; code matches this behavior, so no omission.

omissions.description: POST /api/users/login returns 401 Unauthorized on wrong password as required
omissions.reasoning: Code correctly returns 401 on invalid login; no omission.

omissions.description: User creation enforces uniqueness of username and email with 400 error and message 'Username and email must be unique'
omissions.reasoning: Code implements uniqueness checks and error messages as required.

omissions.description: Slug generation appends random suffix to ensure uniqueness for articles with duplicate titles
omissions.reasoning: Code uses slugify with random suffix as required.

omissions.description: Article timestamps 'created' and 'updated' are set on creation and updated on article update
omissions.reasoning: Code sets and updates timestamps as required.

omissions.description: GET /api/articles supports filtering by tag and author and pagination with limit and offset
omissions.reasoning: Code implements filtering and pagination as required.

omissions.description: GET /api/articles/feed supports pagination with limit and offset
omissions.reasoning: Code implements feed pagination as required.

omissions.description: GET /api/articles/{slug}/comments returns comments with id as number and body preserved
omissions.reasoning: Code returns comments with id and body as required.

omissions.description: POST /api/articles/{slug}/comments returns article with comments array including the new comment
omissions.reasoning: Code returns article with comments included after comment creation.

omissions.description: DELETE /api/articles/{slug}/comments/{id} allows comment deletion by comment author or article author
omissions.reasoning: Code allows deletion by comment author or article author; specification only requires comment author, so this is an addition (see A1).

omissions.description: GET /api/profiles/{username} returns profile with following status relative to viewer
omissions.reasoning: Code returns profile with following field as required.
